# Start here: Build your first agentic workflow

Welcome to the **Agentic Workflows workshop**. You will compile and run a prebuilt workflow, create another workflow, and then make the first workflow review test changes automatically on pull requests.

Open `README.md` at the repository root and use it as the complete workshop guide:

1. Complete **Step 1: Install and verify the prerequisites**.
2. Compile, commit, and manually run the prebuilt Test Quality Checker.
3. Complete one starter workflow or create a small workflow of your own.
4. Update the Test Quality Checker to run for pull requests changing `tests/**`.
5. Open the test-change pull request and watch the workflow post its review comment.

You are finished when the test-change pull request automatically runs the Test Quality Checker and contains its comment or an explicit no-op result.
